title: Pairs With Sum Divisible by X
body:
Amazon offers a discount on every purchase of a pair of products whose cost sum is divisible by x. Given the cost of n products in cost, count the pairs (i, j) with i < j for which cost[i] + cost[j] is divisible by x.

Function to complete

Complete findPairs(x, cost). It returns the number of pairs whose cost sum is divisible by x.

  • x: the divisor
  • cost: the list of product costs

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
inp: The first line is x. The second line is n. Each of the next n lines is one cost[i].
out: The value your function returns (the driver prints it): the number of pairs whose cost sum is divisible by x.

samples.ex: The pairs that sum to a multiple of 60 are (31, 29), (25, 35) and (85, 35), so the answer is 3.
(3, 7), (3, 27), (23, 7) and (23, 27) each sum to a multiple of 10, so the answer is 4.
